name: James : A Faith That Works

provenance.detail: The official Crossroads Church playlist James : A Faith That Works (PLSDa13_3L-B0Ol9Zc64SZjWvQt2mUkXYV) contains these eleven sermon uploads.
Across the messages Josh identifies the church’s series through James; Christian Care explicitly concludes the series and describes it as a call to be doers of the Word.

description: Eleven messages move through James from faith tested under pressure to a church that prays, restores wanderers, and actively cares for one another. James repeatedly tests Christian claims by visible obedience: perseverance, impartial mercy, living faith, disciplined speech, heavenly wisdom, humble dependence, patient waiting, and practical service.
note: The official playlist contains eleven sermons in newest-first order. Members are authored here in chronological order from September 8 through November 24, 2025; no playlist sermon was added for the October 27 gap.
